items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] “Bahia?” [INTERVIEWEE] No. It’s “Interlude” after oh I forgot the song it’s after.

ctx.x: “That’s the Way of the World.” That still to this day that has to be one of my favorite interludes of all times.

No. It’s “Interlude” after oh I forgot the song it’s after. But it’s a [scats]. Anyway they were ahead of their time for that. That “Interlude” it’s literally my favorite interlude ever. It’s like 45 seconds and it’s so dope. You know. And they way they did it was dope and ahead of their time the way they did it too. They took something and flipped it, they took something, another song of theirs, “Celebration,” and flipped it and flipped the tape and made it go backwards. And then Bobby Lyle soloed over it going…
